content.text:
**Analyzing Grid Pattern**

I've been analyzing the input grid, specifically focusing on the rectangular block with the magenta color (6). The output row exhibits an alternating pattern of the color 6 and the color 0. I suspect this will be the key to understanding the transformation. The row output is defined in part by the block's width.
